main_text.l: f. m. R. נָגַע [?]
וּמִגִּיעַ et à labore ejus, No. יָגִיעַ, f. m. præf. & aff. Rad. יָגַע laboravit.
יַגִּיפוּ occludent, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. R. נָגַף.
יָגִיר, vel יָגַר fundet, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. & יַגִּירֵהוּ facient diffluere eum, 3. pl. m. aff. R. נָגַר.
יַגִּישׁ afferant, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. R. נָגַשׁ.
יָגַל exultabit, וַיָּגַל et exultavit, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. Rad. גּוּל. וַיָּגֵל et volvetur, fut. Niph.
יָגַל emigrabit, fut. Kal, וַיָּגַל & deportavit, fut. Hiph. Rad. גָּלָה migravit, vel גָּלַל volvit.
יִגְלוּ migrabunt, fut. Kal; יִגְלוּ revelabuntur, Niphal; יִגְלוּ retegent, Piel; יִגְלוּ deportabunt, Hiphil, 3. pl. m. Rad. גָּלָה.
יִגְמַל educabitur, fut. Niph.
3. f. m. R. נָמַל.
יָגֵן proteget, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. נָגַן.
יִגְנֹב furto auferetur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. גָּנַב.
וַיַּגֵּשׁ et admovit, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. נָגַשׁ.
יִגַּע attingent, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. R. נָגַע.
יִגְעוּ laborabunt, Jef.65.23. pro יגעו, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. Rad. יָגַע.
יִגְּפֶנּוּ percutiet, יִגְּפֶנּוּ eum, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. aff. Rad. נָגַף.
וַיִּגֹּר et fudit, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. נָגַר.
יָגַר ruminabit, Lev. 11.7. fut. Kal, 3. f. m. pro יָנוּר, Rad. גָּרַר.
יִגְרָה miscebit, fut. Piel, 3. f. m. R. גָּרָה.
יָגוּרְךָ commorabitur tecum, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. aff. R. גּוּר.
יִגְרֶם conteret, fut. Piel, 3. f. m. R. גָּרַם.

page.notes: The Hebrew vowel points and dagesh marks are small and worn in the scan, so the exact pointing of many forms is uncertain and should be checked against a clean copy. Marked [?]: the running head letters at the top, the catchword, and the first Hebrew line, whose form is partly cut off at the top of the column. The entries are abbreviated grammatical notes (fut., Hiph., Niph., Kal, Piel, Rad., R., aff., pro) printed as they appear. Latin and Hebrew are kept separate, as printed. Some reference and abbreviation forms (No., Jef., Lev.) are copied as printed.
